thread:
Alex: FYI — just realised we have a coverage gap for EU night this Sat (PDT weekend). Marie is on PTO and Josh is already primary on another shift. Can someone pick up primary or a primary->secondary swap? :alarm_clock:

Marie: sorry y'all — confirmed PTO, can't take any shifts. Hoping a volunteer can step in, thanks.

Oncall Bot: Automatic reminder: upcoming weekend coverage gap detected for timezone EU/CET. Suggested runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-night-handoff (read-only). Paging policy: pagerduty -> primary -> secondary -> oncall-escalation.

Josh: I can take secondary if someone can be primary. I'm on call Sat morning (UTC) for a different rotation but can help shadow.

Priya: I can cover primary for the night (22:00-06:00 CET) but need a quick handoff doc and any active incidents to be listed.

Alex: Awesome, Priya — can you take primary then? Josh secondary works. I'll update the schedule and the PagerDuty escalation policy now.

Alex: Quick customer-impact check: any open incidents that would carry into weekend? @Oncall Bot can you post recent P0/P1s in last 72h?

Oncall Bot: Recent alerts (last 72h):
- 1791880001 - transient slow responses on hosted API (resolved, mitigated by autoscale)
- 1791923456 - minor embedders degradation (ongoing monitoring, no customer-facing errors)
- 1791999999 - spike in retry rate for a set of dedicated pods (opened an incident, assigned to infra-team)

Marie: the infra incident has a follow-up in eng-infra channel, not blocking for app-level but might need to be tracked overnight in case of regressions.

Priya: good to know. If it's not customer-facing I can take primary. Would like a one-paragraph handoff summary from whoever handled the infra issue.

Josh: Pulled the infra thread earlier — main action is a config rollback if GPU driver flakiness reappears. I can add that to the runbook notes.

Alex: Hand-off checklist (quick):
```
- Confirm PagerDuty primary/secondary set for Sat 22:00-06:00 CET
- Snapshot active incidents + brief status
- Ensure runbook links and playbooks pinned in channel
- Post to #eng-oncall at start/end of shift
- Contact list: infra on-call, platform lead, escalation manager
```

Priya: copying that into my notes. Can someone post the exact PD schedule change so I can verify I get alerts?

Alex: done — updated schedule and added Priya as primary, Josh as secondary (changes should propagate in ~2m). PagerDuty event: https://pagerduty.com/INC/PD-12345

PagerDuty: Schedule change processed: Priya is now Primary for rotation EU-NIGHT on 2026-03-21 22:00 CET -> 2026-03-22 06:00 CET.

Priya: got the PD test alert. :thumbsup: Quick question — any special throttles/batching configs we should be aware of for EU traffic while I'm primary?

Josh: No config toggles planned. If latency spikes, prefer routing to fallback model variant (see runbook section "fallback-routing"). Don't toggle quantization profiles unless infra tells you to.

Alex: Also, if any customer-impacting P0 appears, follow escalation steps:
1) page platform lead + infra L2
2) open incident doc and add summary to internal status page
3) if public outage, coordinate with comms (CC: product ops)

Priya: noted. I'll post a start-of-shift message 10m before 22:00 CET and include the incident links. Thanks for the fast handoff everyone.

Josh: I'll stay available for escalation. Good luck, Priya.

Alex: Closing loop — thanks all. If anything changes ping here or DM. :raised_hands:
